mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the activities undertaken by organization in pursuant to its objectives as indicated in the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association."
Operating activities of an organization are the activities undertaken by organization in pursuant to its objectives as indicated in the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamental measures of business performance."
ROCE is a fundamental measures of business performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the current period cash inflows less cash outflows."
Cash flow refers to the current period cash inflows less cash outflows.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between income and expenses over a period of time (usually one year)."
Profit is the difference between income and expenses over a period of time (usually one year).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those businesses which are being carried on by two or more persons with a view of profit."
Partnerships are those businesses which are being carried on by two or more persons with a view of profit.

A fixed charge is a mortgage on specific assets, under which the company loses the right to deal with the assets charged, except with the consent of the mortgaged.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means buying back of shares from the shareholders by the company in accordance with earlier agreement."
Redeeming of shares simply means buying back of shares from the shareholders by the company in accordance with earlier agreement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to show the enterprise financial strengths and flexibility by indicating the pattern of cash generation and utilization."
Cash flows statements are used to show the enterprise financial strengths and flexibility by indicating the pattern of cash generation and utilization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined by the memorandum of Association which can be altered within the limits provided by the companies Act 1968."
Powers are defined by the memorandum of Association which can be altered within the limits provided by the companies Act 1968.

Introduction A company can be defined as a business owned by an association of people, and operated as a legal person on behalf of its owners with the usual motive of profit maximization.

A higher P/E ratio means that investor will pay no more to acquire the business shares in the future.
